# Epic Digital Hub

> Growth studio in Oradea, Romania. We build and operate the full digital
> system behind a brand — strategy, identity, website, content, ads, SEO and
> photo-video — and we work with only one brand per niche, per city.

## Languages

The site is published in Romanian and English. Romanian is the default and the
primary audience (Oradea, Bihor, Romania).

- Romanian: https://epicdigitalhub.ro/
- English:  https://epicdigitalhub.ro/en

Both carry the same content; they are translations of one another, not
different offerings.

## The rule that defines us

One niche. One city. One brand. If we work with a dental clinic in Oradea, we
do not take another dental clinic in Oradea. Your category is yours for as long
as we work together. Everything we learn about your market works for you alone:
no recycled positioning, no shared creative. If a category is already taken in
a city, we say so directly rather than selling an exception.

## What we do

- Marketing strategy — positioning, offer, channels, budget; the plan the rest
  of the system executes.
- Brand and design — identity, guidelines, and every asset the channels need.
- Premium websites — cinematic, interactive, built to convert without giving up
  speed or SEO.
- Paid ads — Meta and Google, reviewed weekly, cut when they stop earning.
- Photo-video — shot at the client's location, edited for ads, social and web.

We also run SEO, social and content, email and retention, and campaign planning
as part of the same system rather than as separate products.

## Verticals we have depth in

Automotive retail, dental clinics, agro machinery, hotels and hospitality,
events and nightlife, construction systems — across Oradea and Bihor.

## Track record

6500+ hours worked inside client systems. 40+ strategies and campaign plans
written. 1200+ pieces of content shipped. 150+ videos filmed and edited. 500+
graphics delivered. 7 verticals operated.

## How to start

Tell us your city and your niche. If the category is open we show you what the
system would look like for your brand; if it is taken we say so. Answer within
two working days.
